text.tspan: Smallpox death rate versus life expectancy in Sweden
The period life expectancy at birth versus the smallpox death rate per 10,000 people in Sweden.
Data source: Riley (2005); Zijdeman et al. (2015); HMD (2025); UN WPP (2024); Edwardes (1902)
Note: Shown is the ‘period life expectancy’. This is the average number of years a newborn would live if age-specific mortality rates in the
current year were to stay the same throughout its life.
